comment: Great teacher, great at teaching, cares about his students, prepares you for the test, and actually teaches you so that you fundamentally understand calc 3.

really good teacher
will take next time

He always has lectures prepared with presentations before each class. Lectures are all the material you need to be prepared for homework problems and exams, and are posted on blackboard if you want to review. He stays after class to go over any problems, and is very helpful with questions. He is far and away the best prof. I've had in math here.

Professor Ross is very humorous and arranges some exercises after each class.  These exercises do not count toward your grade, but if you do them yourself, the course will be much easier.  If you have any problems with the exercises, you can ask for help during office hour.  Do everything possible to solve the problem, Professor Ross will help you.
Funny professor. Explains a lot of the concepts through comp sci and physics so if you aren't those you'll be confused, but overall helpful and works through many examples.

Dr. Ross is a sweet teacher. He evidently puts a lot of time into preparing for the course (ex. prepped notes beforehand), and the preparation he puts in beforehand enhances the quality of the class. He is very knowledgeable about the subject matter, and willing and able to answer questions.

Here's what to expect: attend class and copy notes straight from the board (no trying it on your own or with partners in class), complete Webassign problems (2-3 hours for each assignment), quiz every Friday, only exam is the final. I did well but I can honestly say I didn't genuinely learn anything- I just memorized the steps/problems.

Ross is a great professor and a great math teacher. No essays, two tests, but you have to create several videos on geometric proofs. The class is honestly pointless, but if you enjoy math and geometry it's not too difficult.
This man's grading is whack and his quizzes are all oral. Birth of Euclidean geometry aint it bruh. Class and text is so boring all you wanna do is sleep.

I've had Ross before, but his lectures in Advanced Calc are really great. He combines his passion for the history of mathematics with beautiful, simple proofs to complex results. While his exams are not always easy I would recommend this class just for the lectures, which are the best I've ever had.

Dr. Ross is a very caring and easygoing professor. His lectures are limited in explanation and very example heavy. His semester exams can be challenging but he is a very fair grader. Final is repeated questions from study guide although the guide is 250 problems. Lenient grading system, so easier to make an A than others (90+ is an A). Good guy!
Ross is amazing. He teaches the class well, tells humorous jokes, and gives little homework and easy tests. Highly recommend his MATH 235!

Dr. Ross is really funny and a great guy. He does a great job of working through examples with the class, even though the lectures can get a little dry (mostly due to the content). Virtually all of your final grade comes from exams and the final.

Dr. Ross is very passionate about math and he gets very excited during his lectures!! He assigns 4 papers, but he is very helpful during office hours. If you are interested in the history of mathematics, you are going to learn some very interesting things!

Dr. Ross teaches the material well, and the tests are manageable because he gives you a set of review questions that are similar to actual test questions. The homework is online and tends to be more difficult than the examples he does in class. He goes out of his way to be available for questions/to work out problems with you though. Funny guy too!

Hes a smart professor and tries his best to make students understand. You cant go wrong with hw, though theres plenty of it. Wont need the book because he covers everything in class. If you pay attention to class you should be good.
I love this professor. He is so great! I will definitely take his class again.

At the start of the semester, he will make you think that his class is fun and interesting. Well, as the semester moves on, you'll begin to regret it. He is smart, no doubt about that. But he teaches his class the way the graduate students are taught. He often assumes that students know stuff already which isn't true. Oh, he's also condescending.

In my opinion, the professor does not respect students. He is kind of arrogant to us, giving the feeling that he is the boss, and that students and he do not have the equal positions. He is not like other nice math professors that are students' friends.

The class was generally enjoyable, but the material seemed rather superficial until the exams (which is rather unfortunate from the test-taking standpoint). I certainly wouldn't avoid taking classes with Dr. Ross, but I probably wouldn't take a course exclusively because he's teaching it, either.

Friendly guy and willing to help.  His teaching style is introducing  new topics and monotonously writing out several examples extremely fast every single class while occasionally making semi-funny comments .  Exams are unnecessarily difficult, regardless of if practice problems are provided.
Great Prof!! Love him!!

Dr. Ross's classes are sometimes boring but, he will always always go out of his way to help you before tests. He has review sessions and is available during office hours if you don't understand something. He has a wonderfully quirky sense of humor that keeps class interesting. One of the best math professors at Richmond.

He simply is the best teacher I have had at Richmond. He explains the material very well and goes over homework problems in detail. If you want to take any Calc class, I suggest you sign up for his class. And also, he is  funny. So no matter how hard you may try, you wouldn't get bored in his class.

the worst professor ever. he'll make you write the homework on the computer just because he thinks everyone has the same bad handwriting as him.  his tests are hard, he'll give you problems you haven't seen before and each homework is sooooo long it will take you 7 hours or more. don't take him!!!

I've always had a hard time with Math. Failed classes in high school, and never thought I'd do more than absolutely necessary in college. However, Ross makes the material very accessible, is always ready to help, and I've now taken three math classes and love it!

decent professor. grades homework every day. workload isn't too bad but the tests are pretty hard. he's eager to help students outside of class but pretty much  just gives you the answers to the homework when you go.

his tests are hard, but he gives several practice tests that are very similar. he also counts an A as 90-100 and an A- as an 89 etc, which is really nice for your GPA no matter what grade you get. his notes can be sparce, but he take alot of time to go over problems in class, which is super helpful. probably wont find a better calc prof. at UR

Ross is the hardest teacher I've ever had. The class itself is extremely hard, and Ross does nothing to help out. He takes shortcuts and doesn't explain his methods, and while maybe not his fault, the textbook does the exact same thing, so there is usually no place to go for help. Too much is left unexplained.
I would not recommend taking this guy unless you've taken calc in high school. Really nice guy, but not always clear when explaining concepts. Tests were really hard.

I like him!I really think he is not for everybody but he likes what he is doing!He helps and does not evade questions like some others in the math department!He is challenging, which a lot of people find hard to cope with!He is funny and knows what he is talking about!

okay these people who rated him before liked math. for those of you who don't, here's a few details: yea he is nice, but his tests are ridiculous. you can understand all of the hw concepts and still get screwed over on a test- it's not set up so that you do well even if you get everything and study...  not cool.
Great teacher, and willing to help with anything you don't get.  You should definently take him.

most people have trouble in calc 2 unless you have professor ross.  he is a really nice, soft spoken, funny man.  he wants to help his students and will go out of his way to help you if you ask for help.  i highly recommend him!!

Ross is a really great Math Prof. Its hard to find someone that can break down the concepts in calc so that undergraduates can understand it. His test are hard, and his homework can be both long and difficult, butif you do all the practice problems there are no surprises on the exam. I enjoyed it.
No Comments
Teaches high level math classes so it makes sense that most courses he teaches are difficult, but is a very fair teacher and extremely helpful.  Also just and very nice person.
Dr. Ross is such a good professor.  If you take time to see him out side of class, he will work with you through any problem.  He makes his classes very hard, but it's worth it, you learn so much.

Impossible.  Makes things 4 times harder than it could be becuase he's just so out there.  you can tell he's a genius and it's hard for him to stoop down to anyone's level. half of his calc IV class dropped out after the 1st day.
